publisher.legalNameZh: 广东深河中科生物科技有限公司
publisher.role: Manufacturer — the entity named on the reports below

note: These are the third-party laboratory reports this factory holds and publishes. Each record carries the issuing body, the report number as printed on the document, the product line it covers, and the file itself. A report number is the part a buyer quotes back, so each one resolves to exactly one page and one file. The reports document the products made here; a private-label version of the same formula needs its own testing for the claims the buyer intends to make.

reports.title: Pet deodorant — ammonia removal
reports.finding: Ammonia 1.53 → 0.088 mg/m³, a 94.2% removal, on the pet deodorant sample.
reports.context: The determination behind the 94.2% ammonia figure quoted on every deodorizing SKU. 1.53 → 0.088 mg/m³, measured on the Power Odor Eliminator (Extra Strength) / PURE PAWS PET DEODORANT sample.

verification.how: Issued by the Guangzhou Institute of Microbiology (NACC), a third-party laboratory. No public report lookup was found for this institute, so the report number and the document itself are the evidence. Ask the factory for the original file, or ask the institute directly.

reports.title: Pet deodorant — hydrogen sulfide removal

reports.title: Disinfectant — available chlorine stability and acute oral toxicity
reports.issuer: Guangzhou Institute of Microbiology Group Co., Ltd.
reports.finding: Available chlorine 130 mg/L, and 111 mg/L after 14 days at 54 °C — a 14.6% fall.
reports.findingShort: Available chlorine 130 mg/L, 111 mg/L after 14 days at 54 °C — a 14.6% fall.
reports.context: Three determinations on the Disinfectant & Deodorizing Solution (sodium hypochlorite) sample: pH 6.96 at 25 °C; available chlorine 130 mg/L before storage against 111 mg/L after 14 days at 54 °C — a 14.6% fall, inside the ≤15% that GB/T 38499-2020 sets for a one-year shelf life; and an acute oral toxicity test on 20 mice.
reports.issuedBy: Guangzhou Institute of Microbiology Group Co., Ltd.

verification.body: Guangzhou Institute of Microbiology Group Co., Ltd.
verification.how: Issued by the Guangzhou Institute of Microbiology Group Co., Ltd., a third-party laboratory. The number carries the group's own XJ entrustment prefix, and the report is a five-page document with the sample name and the entrusting party printed on it. No public lookup page was found for XJ numbers, so the buyer writes to the group quoting the number and the sample name.

reports.title: Purepaws neutralising spray — full analysis
reports.finding: Kill rates above 99.999% against Trichophyton mentagrophytes and Microsporum canis.
reports.findingShort: Kill rates above 99.999% against two test fungi.
reports.context: Fungicidal experiment under GB/T 27404.1.1.9 on the CatClean Antifungal & Deodorizing Solution sample: kill rates above 99.999% against Trichophyton mentagrophytes CMCC(F)T5b and Microsporum canis ATCC 10214. An entrustment analysis report — not a factory audit.

verification.how: Ask Guangdong Detection Center of Microbiology to confirm the report. Their report-authenticity service is at https://www.gddcm.com/a/customer/jinduchaxun/ and covers samples the centre accepted from 2024-01-01 onward, which includes this report. The lookup asks for the entrustment number the factory was given when the sample was submitted; the report number printed on the document is what identifies the report itself. The centre can also be called on 020-87137666.
